cuts.script: Noah steps up alongside her, holding heavy leather work gloves in one hand.

dialogue.spoken_text: We will see how long those clean boots last.

cuts.script: Jenna turns and looks down at his clean polo and unscratched boots.

dialogue.spoken_text: Lead the way.

cuts.script: Noah pulls on the work gloves and follows her toward the pallet rows.

beat_d9f7e846.preview_narration: When Noah first walked onto Jenna's busy warehouse floor, everything about him seemed far too polished for hard labor.
beat_d9f7e846.seam: Noah pulls on his leather work gloves and follows Jenna down the central concrete aisle.
beat_d9f7e846.title: The Rookie
beat_d9f7e846.visual_description: Jenna Morales stands beside a yellow aisle marker holding a metal clipboard, turning to look at Noah Sterling who stands two paces back holding thick leather work gloves. Behind them, tall steel racking aisles stretch beneath cool morning skylights.
